content: अवच्छिन्न {%<ab>p. p.</ab>%} .²1 Cut off. .²2 Separated, divided, detached, excerpted; अवच्छिन्नस्य पूर्णेन एकत्वं प्रतिपाद्यते <ls>A. Rām. 1. 1. 49</ls>. .²3 (In Logic) Separated or excluded from all other things by the properties predicated of a thing as peculiar to itself. .²4 Bounded, modified, determined; दिक्कालाद्यनवच्छिन्न <ls>Bh. 2. 1</ls>. .²5 Particularized, distinguished, characterized, as by an attributive word.
